targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM proxies WHERE active = true AND stability_status = 'Stable' AND location IN ($location)
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM proxies WHERE active = true AND stability_status = 'UnstableHourly' AND location IN ($location)
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM proxies WHERE active = true AND stability_status = 'UnstableDaily' AND location IN ($location)

SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00')) as time_sec, COUNT(CASE WHEN stability_status = 'Stable' THEN 1 END) as stable, COUNT(CASE WHEN stability_status = 'UnstableHourly' THEN 1 END) as unstable_hourly, COUNT(CASE WHEN stability_status = 'UnstableDaily' THEN 1 END) as unstable_daily FROM proxies WHERE active = true AND $__timeFilter(updated_at) AND location IN ($location) GROUP BY time_sec ORDER BY time_sec

SELECT name, location, stability_status, last_ip, same_ip_count, rotation_count, updated_at FROM proxies WHERE active = true AND stability_status IN ('UnstableHourly', 'UnstableDaily') AND location IN ($location) ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT CONCAT(country, ' - ', state, ' - ', city) as location_detail, stability_status, COUNT(*) as count FROM proxies WHERE active = true AND location IN ($location) GROUP BY location_detail, stability_status ORDER BY location_detail

list.name: location
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT location FROM proxies WHERE location IS NOT NULL
